key_impacts: Storm surge flooding in New York City exceeded 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
About 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Two New Jersey refineries (Port Reading and Bayway) were shut down, reducing operating capacity by 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate due to power outages.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
